nodes.title: Work In Progress: Towards Adaptive RF Fingerprint-based Authentication of IIoT devices
nodes.methodology: Leveraging AI-driven adaptive Radio Frequency Fingerprinting (RFF) at the PHY layer, combined with Software-Defined Radio (SDR) gateways and Edge/Cloud computing to enhance feature extraction and authentication accuracy.
nodes.contribution: Introduce AI techniques for self-tuning RF fingerprinting, enabling flexible and accurate IIoT authentication while addressing scalability and heterogeneity challenges.

nodes.title: DeepCRF: Deep Learning-Enhanced CSI-Based RF Fingerprinting for Channel-Resilient WiFi Device Identification
nodes.dataset: 19 COTS WiFi NICs with CSI measurements across diverse channel conditions, including real-world unseen scenarios.
nodes.methodology: DeepCRF employs a CNN with model-inspired data augmentation, supervised contrastive learning, and decision fusion to enhance generalization and noise resilience in CSI-based fingerprinting.
nodes.contribution: Introduces DeepCRF with three key contributions: micro-CSI extraction via CNN, complex-valued CSI processing, and noise-robust fusion techniques.

nodes.title: Federated Radio Frequency Fingerprint Identification Powered by Unsupervised Contrastive Learning
nodes.dataset: 60 commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) LoRa transmitters and 6 software-defined radio (SDR) receivers.
nodes.methodology: Proposes a federated RFFI protocol with three stages: federated pre-training, client fine-tuning, and identification, using unsupervised contrastive learning for feature extraction.
nodes.contribution: Introduces a federated RFFI protocol with unsupervised contrastive learning, ensuring trainability, scalability, and NN security through three-stage protocol design.

nodes.title: RF eigenﬁngerprints, an Efﬁcient RF Fingerprinting Method in IoT Context
nodes.dataset: Extended Yale Face database B for eigenfaces; novel baseband model for emitter impairments (I/Q offset, imbalance, PA nonlinearity).
nodes.methodology: Proposes RF eigenﬁngerprints inspired by eigenfaces, using singular value decomposition (SVD) for feature learning, Ljung–Box test for selection, and statistical models for authentication. Includes simulation, real-world experiments, and FPGA implementation.
nodes.contribution: Adapts eigenfaces to RF fingerprinting, introduces a novel impairment model, provides FPGA implementation, and enables feature interpretability.

nodes.title: SMoRFFI: A Large-Scale Same-Model 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi Dataset and Reproducible Framework for RF Fingerprinting
nodes.dataset: Two CSV datasets: (1) RFFI-IQ_only-wifi-802.11g-2.4G-123-m5stack (MAC addresses and preamble samples) and (2) RFFI-kf_feature-IQ-wifi-802.11g-2.4G-123-m5stack (multi-dimensional RF features including CFO, phase error, magnitude error, and fractal dimension).
nodes.methodology: A large-scale dataset of 123 same-model IEEE 802.11g devices with 35.42 million raw I/Q samples and 1.85 million RF features is created. A reproducible framework with data collection, feature extraction, and benchmark evaluation modules is developed.
nodes.contribution: Introduces a large-scale, homogeneous dataset for same-model devices and an open-source framework for reproducible RF fingerprinting research.
